name: channel3
description: Product search, discovery, and API integration skills powered by Channel3

plugins.name: channel3-api
plugins.description: Integrate the Channel3 API for product search (text, image, semantic, and agentic), similar-products recommendations, multi-merchant offer comparison, URL lookup, conversational shopping agents, price tracking, click/transaction reporting, and affiliate commissions across TypeScript, Python, and REST — plus a React component library (shadcn registry) for storefront UIs

plugins.name: product-discovery
plugins.description: Search for real product data — prices, availability, merchant links, and 'more like this' recommendations — across thousands of retailers using the Channel3 CLI
